## Description
**What**: /dso:sprint reads the persisted migration-class marker from the plan header (without recomputing detection) and wires each emitted migration task pair with depends_on so the dependent half is scheduled after the half it validates; the two-pass flow is documented in sprint/SKILL.md.
**Why**: Out-of-order scheduling would verify or clean up before the work it checks exists; consuming the persisted marker also avoids local/CI detection divergence.
**Scope**:
- IN: marker consumption (no recompute); per-pair-type depends_on wiring (sweep, db, feature-flag); absent-marker fallback; SKILL.md documentation.
- OUT: emission of the pairs (separate stories); marker classification.

## Done Definitions
- /dso:sprint reads the migration-class marker from the plan header and does not recompute detection
  ← Satisfies: sc-5  (sc-5: sprint two-pass consumption)
- For each automated-sweep / manual-verification pair, sprint sets the verification task's depends_on to the sweep task and schedules the sweep in an earlier batch
  ← Satisfies: sc-5
- For db-class markers, sprint wires the rollback-verification task to depend_on the forward migration task so the forward migration is scheduled earlier
  ← Satisfies: sc-5
- For feature-flag pairs, sprint wires the flag-removal cleanup task to depend_on the flag-guarded cutover task so the cutover is scheduled earlier
  ← Satisfies: sc-5
- When no migration-class marker is present in the plan header, standard batch ordering applies unchanged
  ← Satisfies: sc-5
- sprint/SKILL.md documents the two-pass flow with a self-contained instruction and an explicit absent-marker fallback
  ← Satisfies: sc-5
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic
  ← Satisfies: sc-5

## Considerations
- [Correctness] Sprint binds to the marker schema defined by the detection story; treat the marker as read-only.

## Escalation Policy
**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a sprint orchestrator, I read the migration-class marker and apply two-pass ordering
